name: Move the "Playing in the dirt" Spot
description: Moves where children go to play in the dirt. In the stock game the spot is a strip of ground that runs from the rainbow totem's side down across the river, so a child playing in the dirt wanders through the water and ends up on the bank behind the research shelves; this makes it the grass field above the lake's north-west edge (between the river, the Hollow Totem and the lake's sandy edge), never in the lake water and never on the Hollow Totem: about 256 by 205 with six random steps inside it. The action, its text, its sound and its length are unchanged. **Off by default, in Owner's Defaults and in Select All. Cannot be used with Puddle Play Moves to the Lake Shore, which sends "Playing in the dirt" to that same grass and the sandy strip below it, and also moves puddle play there once The Lake has water (ticking one unticks the other).**
behavior_changes: A child who starts "Playing in the dirt" walks to a random point of the grass above the lake's north-west edge whose record coordinates are 1304..1559 by 1855..2059 (was 236..453 by 442..475; the second coordinate now steps by two) and wanders inside it for the six steps the stock routine already takes. The box lies inside Puddle Play Moves to the Lake Shore's area: every point is walkable, outside the lake (areas 0x69 and 0x6A) and 41 pixels or more from the Hollow Totem (areas 0x56 and 0x43).
Until v1.35.97 the box was the flower patch east of the dirt path, 1860..2164 by 1479..1683; the owner moved it to the grass by the lake (2026-11-20).
explicit_non_changes: The routine's own 46 bytes are recoded in place -- the stock one-byte spread cannot exceed 127, so the second spread is rand(103) doubled with a lea, paid for by popping the two rand arguments instead of adding to esp -- and the base of the first coordinate changes; no code is added, no executable space is claimed, and the routine's step count, speed and animations are untouched.
The say-event (504, "Playing in the dirt") and its sound are unchanged; no save or villager-record byte is written.

patches.purpose: the two random picks of the Playing-in-the-dirt routine at 0x45ED40: push 0x67 / call rand / lea edi,[eax+eax] / push 0x100 / add edi,0x73F / call rand / pop ecx / pop ecx / push 0 / push 0x64 -- the second coordinate becomes 1855 + 2*rand(103) (1855..2059) and the first pick's spread becomes rand(256); same length, the second call's rel32 recomputed for its new address
the first coordinate's base: `add eax, 0xEC` (236 + rand(218)) becomes 0x518 (1304..1559); this value lands in the villager's first position field (+0x1C98)
